text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria got injured during training, 
so I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow... I really thought I could 
pull that off...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I guess I got a little too excited! Ahaha—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Can't we keep going just a little longer? 
With the training, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...I felt like I was really growing at a 
great pace just now!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If I stop now, I feel like... I'll get 
rusty! So please, let me continue!
choice_data_list: Even so, I want you to rest for now.

...If I think it's dangerous, I'll stop 
it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If it gets worse... that'd be a 
hundred-mile detour, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—All right! Switch gears, switch gears! 
Gran Alegria, going all out on rest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My favorite Diet broadcast, a 
horseshoe-shaped neck pillow, and... Oh, I 
know! I'll try an eye mask too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave Gran Alegria my full support as she 
began preparing for her rest period.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll be very careful!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Tiptoe, tiptoe—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Ah... ouch!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she was stopped eventually, pushing 
herself had already aggravated the injury.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, only where it doesn't 
hurt—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...There, there, this looks like it'll be 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, as expected of me! There's no 
stopping the growth of the Mile Queen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, making sure not to overdo it, 
we were able to complete the training 
session without issue.
